Package dev.px.core.service

Class ServiceContainer

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.service.ServiceContainer
public final class ServiceContainer extends Object
Holds the client's services and starts them in dependency order.

Ordering is a topological sort over Service.dependsOn(), with registration order preserved among independent services so startup stays deterministic. A dependency cycle or a missing dependency is reported with the services involved rather than surfacing later as a null field.

Shutdown runs in reverse start order, and a service that throws while stopping is logged and skipped so one bad teardown cannot strand the rest.
